QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] Behold the Pendant
QuestInfo.0: Arnello's town is being attacked by evil dragons. Help him.
QuestInfo.1: You got a pendant after defeating the evil dragon. Using the pendant gave you a powerful energy.
QuestInfo.2: The spirit of the pendant does not entrust its powers to just anyone. You must prove your pure intentions (if they really are pure) to claim the power.
